desc: Formalize good captions as partitions into maximal monochromatic runs of length at least 3.
Derive cost model (absolute alphabet distance per position) and suffix DP over (position, last char, capped run length 1/2/3).
Optimize the k==3 min-over-c != last transition to O(1) per (i,last) using best/second-best over |s[i]-c| + A[i+1][c].
Store A (k=1) and C (k=3) as flat arrays for memory, keeping B (k=2) only for the next backward step.
Implement greedy lexicographic reconstruction choosing the smallest char achieving the optimal cost at each step, ensuring every run length >= 3.
Handle edge cases: n < 3 returns "", tie-breaking by smallest first character, and forced continuations for k < 3.
Validate against provided examples ("cdcd"->"cccc", "aca"->"aaa", "bc"->"") via reasoning/brute force; solution appears correct and complete.
